title:
Selling within 4 years?
*Seller's stamp duty*

lines.say: You bought a condo in 2025 and want to sell after two and a half years. You could owe 8% in stamp duty.
For private homes bought from 4 July 2025, seller's stamp duty lasts four years.
Sell in the first year: 16%. Second year: 12%.
Third year: 8%. Fourth year: 4%. After that, nothing.
On a 1.6 million dollar sale in year three, that's 128,000 dollars.
HDB flats aren't affected, because of the minimum occupation period.
Save this before you plan your exit.
lines.cap: *save this* before you plan your exit
lines.stat: Higher of price or market value

caption:
Bought a condo in 2025 and want to sell after two and a half years? You could owe 8% seller's stamp duty. 🏢

For private homes bought from 4 July 2025, SSD lasts four years: 16% in year 1, 12% in year 2, 8% in year 3, 4% in year 4, then nothing. On a $1.6M sale in year three, that's $128,000. HDB flats aren't affected because of the MOP.

Save this before you plan your exit 👇

Charged on the higher of price or market value.
